Name: Marnie Deserves Better
Author: IllogicalMoodSwing
Description:
This mod slightly changes the vanilla 6-heart event with Marnie and Lewis, and adds a new two-part event to amend the narrative around their relationship. Eventually I intend to add or change dialogue of the villagers to show their support, and maybe even flesh out the new events, but for now I just wanted to give Marnie the support she deserves!

Install
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
